review_comments.body:
** Major** · **Data Integrity & Integration** · **Quick win** **Record the pricing identity on the usage row.** When a recorded batch returns a different served model, these lines price `record.provider:record.model`, but `log_batch_usage` still stores `provider` and `batch_model`. For example, the new test prices `openai:gpt-4o-mini` while the usage row names `openai:gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18`. Usage filtered or grouped by the requested model then omits that cost. Store the recorded provider and model on the usage row, and retain the existing fields for batches without a record. ([raw.githubusercontent.com](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mozilla-ai/otari/6dbb635e8839f1cabe04a278db033e5e043ad42a/src/gateway/api/routes/batches.py))

Happy to send it as a separate PR if the maintainers want rows keyed by the requested model.
